record.title: Kok Ma Watershed Research Station - Thailand

general.abstract: Kok Ma water research station in located at Doi Suthep-Pui National Park about 20 km from Chiang Mai city. The station was established in 1965 by Kasetsart University and University of Hawaii. The altitude of this station ranges between 1,300-1,600 m above mean sea level. The dominant vegetation is hill evergreen forest.
